scope: future-only, paired full-field trot predictions with prospectively sealed roster/clock/market timestamps
hard_gates: original source publication as-of before race T-4 verified
immutable scheduled time revisions / earlier clock provenance verified
immutable complete active field, scratches and provider identity match
source and feature timestamp <= frozen decision timestamp
all model and market probabilities normalized over exact identical selection set
candidate market-free inputs verified with complete field
same race cohort and outcome source for all comparisons
winner result observed after race start, complete official source
no candidate refit on evaluation outcomes

comparison.primary: paired race-level logarithmic loss (candidate minus normalized market-only)
comparison.economic_metrics: separate descriptive layer; no ROI/edge or stake promotion by predictive result alone
comparison.research_candidate: CORE-004 unfitted until pre-experiment training protocol approved

minimum_observation: at least 30 consecutive days for operational M3; matched statistical sample size must be independently preregistered after design/power review
